This article is a stub. Intersil is an American semiconductor company, founded by Jean Hoerni in
1967, that launched the [Cronus](cronus.md) electronic stopwatch in 1973 and was named as its maker
in advertisements to swimmers until 1976.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
